en.name: UMANG (Unified Mobile App for New-age Governance)
en.description: Single mobile app aggregating central, state, and utility services (EPFO, income tax, passport, bill pay, etc.).
en.eligibility: Any citizen with a smartphone; services may need respective IDs.
en.benefits: One app for many government services; multilingual; Aadhaar/PAN-based auth.
faqs: How do I register on UMANG?
What is the official website for this service?
